summary: Jersey City Board of Education candidate, former teacher, software developer, lived in Shanghai, lived in China and Korea, strong anti-union stance regarding teacher pay, believes in merit-based pay for teachers, critical of public school systems, advocates for personal responsibility and self-improvement, identifies as a conservative, skeptical of government intervention, supports free market principles, has lived in the U.S. and abroad, has experience in remote work, interested in real estate investment, has a family, values education and self-initiative, critical of entitlement mentality.
